csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Silverton, Colorado (Town) is seeking Proposals from qualified consultants (Consultant) experienced and interested in providing pre-approved ADU architectural plans suitable for Silverton s lot constraints and overlay districts, including a minimum of one accessible ADU. This scope of work is part of Town s initiative to encourage ADU development in Silverton to support the expansion of housing choices and opportunities, funded through the Department of Local Affairs (DOLA) Accessory Dwelling Unit Grant (ADUG) and the Colorado Housing and Finance Authority.

- Project type does not match sbp priority sectors such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs, or major cultural/university buildings.
